mode: Simulated Google Maps API contract checks; no real Google account or tiles tested

checks.label: Missing key keeps the offline map and gives an explicit message
Google script loading failure restores the offline map
Configured Google map is embedded and receives three shared locations
Google marker opens the existing announcement details
Switching shared notices on Google preserves the real announcement link
Google fit clears the detail and positions all three points
Google markers and result cards share area filtering
Result card selection focuses the same Google location
Google zoom controls call the embedded map
Empty results clear Google markers and the notice
Manual schematic switch hides Google and restores three local markers
A loaded Google view can be selected again
Three basemap controls fit on a phone without horizontal overflow
Mobile Google selector does not overlap the fit control
Going offline restores the schematic and retains the selected notice
A delayed Google response cannot override a newer schematic selection
Google authentication failure restores the offline map
Contract scenarios have no uncaught JavaScript errors
